### Day 243: Acts 13:4–12
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-243-acts-13-412.html
Passage: Acts 13:4-12
Points:
- Following God and stepping out in ministry frequently brings spiritual opposition rather than comfort.
- The enemy actively works through deception and distortion to hinder people from receiving the gospel.
- God supplies the spiritual authority and power needed to overcome demonic resistance.
- A sincere desire to hear God's message prepares the heart to be astonished by His truth.
- Believers must recognize the evil one as the real instigator behind distractions from God's Word.
